existing_frankengate_evidence.e2_label_boundary: publisher task identity and metadata-derived hard negatives, not blinded human similarity labels

adopt: separate proposer, evaluator, and release authority
strict validation gate with regression floors
SkillOpt-Sleep recall/replay as an optional proposal mechanism
defer: cross-user skill sharing without consent and utility labels
fine-tuning or embedding adaptation before a governed hard slice
sending internal traces to external optimizer providers without egress approval

next_decisive_test: Run SkillGen/SkillOpt/RHO-style candidates on the same family-disjoint natural Frankengate traces with no-skill, placebo, expert, mined, and optimized arms; score paired repairs and regressions on independently verified outcomes; require rollback and no unauthorized influence.
